pages.title: Opening the screen
pages.text: Find the RPG Leveling screen binding in Options → Controls → Key Binds. Its default is K.

pages.title: Adjusting a build
pages.text: Check your available points at the top. Scroll to a stat, use +1 or +10 to invest, or −1 to refund. Hover for the contribution. A ! marks a capped stat.
